methods.flux: separable Gaussian error function integral over the aperture
methods.rank: singular values of the joint design matrix

rank_negative.expected: not_identifiable with a nullspace when colour is a function of position

scale_interval.note: the exact measurement must not produce a finite radius; the interval measurement must keep the difference

shared_floor.note: the shared term does not decrease with the number of frames

shared_latent.note: the shared latent creates the off-diagonal term; treating the two rows as independent would give the wrong variance

single_source.note: a finite window does not renormalise the flux

unknown_gain.note: without a gain no electron variance can be derived; the signal stays valid and the variance state must stay unknown
